Introduction

Hojun is a South Korean singer and model. He is a former member of the boy group F.able. Following the group’s last activities in the summer of 2023, he began using his Instagram account for personal updates and modeling-related content. Since late 2024, he has frequently posted product advertisements, dance reels with friends, and snapshots of his daily life, often engaging with fans through comments and stories. He also occasionally hosts live streams on TikTok.
